description: This file contains regular expressions used to classify source file paths, functions to normalize paths, and to classify files as source code, API barrels, test-like files, infrastructure artifacts, or production sources.

methods.name: normalizeExtensionSourcePath
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with forward slashes in file paths to normalize them.

methods.name: classifyBundledExtensionSourcePath
methods.description: Analyzes a file path to determine whether it is a code file, API barrel, test-like file, infrastructure artifact, or a production source based on specific regex patterns.
